sources.citation: Elders, Stefan. 2006. Issues in comparative Kebi-Benue (Adamawa). Africana Linguistica 12: 37-88.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Section 3 (phonology: glottal stop, prenasalisation, vowels, vowel patterns, 3.4 Tone) uses Elders' own Mono field data; sec. 3.4.4 'Low-High tone in Mono' (pp. 61-62) treats Mono as a tone language with Low-High patterns on CVC/CVV/CVCV nouns corresponding to Mundang High-Low. No mention of stress/accent anywhere in the article (a full-text search for stress/accent full scanned: 'stress' only in 'it should be stressed that').
